name: CHiME-6

citation: Watanabe, S., Mandel, M., Barker, J., et al. (2020). CHiME-6 Challenge: Tackling Multispeaker Speech Recognition for Unsegmented Recordings. Proceedings of the 6th International Workshop on Speech Processing in Everyday Environments (CHiME 2020). https://doi.org/10.21437/CHiME.2020-1
